models.name: Muse Spark Open
models.why: Meta's 816B open-weight MoE (42B active, 1M context) that Apple and Meta tuned to run through MLX on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios with 512GB each.

engines.hardware: four M5 Ultra Mac Studios, 512GB each (~1TB unified each pair), Thunderbolt RDMA; Apple Machine Learning Research decode figure with tensor parallelism
engines.quant: MLX distributed inference, 4-bit NVFP4 compressed weights, 1M-token context; decode speed per Apple MLR (25 tok/s on two Studios)

engines.hardware: four M5 Ultra Mac Studios, 816B model spread across them over Thunderbolt RDMA
engines.quant: MLX distributed inference with RDMA; Apple MLX team's own decode figure, no quant named in the post

models.name: LFM2.5 24B A2B
models.why: Liquid AI's 24B MoE with 2B active per token, open weights, runs on llama.cpp and MLX from day one at 184 tok/s on an M5 Max.

engines.quant: MLX build; Liquid AI's reported decode figure, no quant named in the post

models.name: Bonsai 2 9B
models.engine_min_version: ternary GGUF packings need PrismML's llama.cpp fork; upstream llama.cpp loads only the Q2_0 file
models.why: Ternary 9B vision-language model in about 2GB, more than 9x smaller than full precision, runnable on Macs, iPhones and iPads through MLX.

engines.hardware: Apple M5 Max Pro (Arm, MLX via PrismML)
engines.quant: ternary weights (~2GB), PrismML's reported decode figure
